notes: Although catalogued as "Civil Works Bid-Out", this 12-page PDF holds all three forms: Civil Works Bid-Out (pages 1-2, 8 items), Goods and Services Bid-Out (pages 3-11, 49 items, signatures on page 11) and Consulting Services Bid-Out (page 12). They are transcribed as tables civilWorks, goodsServices and consulting.
Consulting Services Bid-Out (page 12): every column is marked "NONE"; no consulting services were bid out this quarter.

Page 2 of the civil works form carries the header "FDP Form 10b - Bid Results on Goods and Services" but its title is "CIVIL WORKS BID-OUT" and it continues the civil works numbering (items 7-8); it is kept in the civilWorks table.
Below the signatures on page 2 there is a stray, unruled text fragment "SEDIBUS INDUSTRIAL & FACILITIES MANAGEMENT CORP. 2,902,982.80" that duplicates item 8; it is not transcribed as a separate row.

Civil works "Name and Address" column prints the contact person followed by the address; the person is in bidderContact and the address in bidderAddress. Item 8 (Sedibus) prints only an address, so bidderContact is null.
Civil works item 8 winning bidder is printed "Sedibus Industrial & Facilities Mangement Corp." (sic, "Mangement").

Goods and services "Name and Address Of Bidder" column repeats the bidder name in bold before the address; only the address is kept in bidderAddress. Where the bold name differs from the Winning Bidder column it reads: "ACE MEDICAL SOLUTIONS, INC.", "COPIER SOURCE ENTERPRISES" (Winning Bidder: "COPIER SOURCE ENTERPRISE"), "EASA PHARMA DISTRIBUTION" (Winning Bidder: "EASA PHARMA DISTRIBUTORS"), "TOYOTA LAPU-LAPU, CEBU" (Winning Bidder: "TOYOTA, LAPU-LAPU CEBU"), "FIVE E PLASTIC MANUFACTURING INC.", "HERITAGE MUEBLES MIRABILE EXPORT, INC.", "STEADFAST BUILDERS CONSTRUCTION CORP.".
Goods item "2,300 PIECES UKELELE": the P.R No. cell is clipped by the column border and only "-0750 & 24-06" is visible; transcribed as visible.

Goods item 24-06-0821 (Laboratory Supplies of City Hospital, OCTAPHARMA CORPORATION): printed bid amount 5,242,216.00 against an ABC of 8,863,980.00. The same bid amount is printed for the preceding INCA PHILIPPINES item 24-07-0943 (ABC 5,250,000.00), so this may be a copy error in the source; transcribed as printed.

bidderNormalized: a canonical spelling added by the transcriber so the same company ranks as one bidder across documents (case, punctuation and obvious misspellings unified, e.g. variants confirmed by the bidder name repeated in the address column or by an identical contact person/address). The printed name is kept unchanged in bidder.
